details: US President Donald Trump stated he faces a "big decision" on whether to resume major military attacks against Iran, telling Axios he would meet with Gulf state leaders next week for their input. This comes amidst ongoing conflict and heightened tensions in the Middle East, with reports of Russian satellite intelligence potentially aiding previous Iranian strikes. The prospect of escalating conflict raises significant concerns for global stability.
title: Trump Weighs "Big Decision" on Resuming Major Iran Attacks

details: China has privately requested Iran to help rein in Yemen's Houthi rebels following an appeal from Saudi Arabia. This diplomatic move comes as Houthi attacks continue to disrupt shipping in the Red Sea and impact Saudi oil infrastructure, including the temporary shutdown of a key East-West oil pipeline. Beijing is reportedly concerned about the impact on its energy security and trade interests.
title: China Urges Iran to Rein in Houthis Amid Red Sea Oil Disruptions

details: The United States and China are reportedly discussing reductions or eliminations of China's tariffs on American liquefied natural gas (LNG). These discussions are part of a broader package of potential energy and agriculture agreements, anticipated to be announced during Chinese President Xi Jinping's upcoming visit to Washington next week. This could signal a de-escalation of trade tensions.
title: US, China Discuss LNG Tariff Cuts Ahead of Xi Jinping Visit

details: US prosecutors are seeking the forfeiture of approximately $61 million in cryptocurrency, alleging it originated from black-market sales of sanctioned Iranian crude oil and was intended to finance Iran's government and military. Concurrently, crypto exchange CoinEx, a key platform for Iranian crypto transactions, announced its shutdown citing a prolonged market downturn and rising compliance costs.
sourceName: Reuters (via Yahoo Finance) / Bank Policy Institute
title: US Seizes $61M in Crypto from Iranian Oil Sales, Exchange Closes

details: The Federal Reserve implemented a 25-basis point interest rate hike in September, its first since 2023. The decision was influenced by persistent inflation and ongoing geopolitical tensions, particularly those involving Iran. This move dampens hopes for near-term rate cuts and raises concerns about stagflation, impacting overall market sentiment and lending activity.
title: Fed Raises Interest Rates Citing Inflation, Geopolitical Tensions
